headword: {方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}

conjugation.prefix: {方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}

definitions.gloss: policy shift; change of direction; reversal of course
definitions.explanation: A deliberate change in an established policy, strategy, or approach. Used in politics, business, and personal decisions.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}が{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced a policy shift.

examples.japanese: {売|う}り{上|あ}げの{低迷|ていめい}を{受|う}けて{経営|けいえい}{方針|ほうしん}の{転換|てんかん}を{図|はか}った。
examples.english: Facing sluggish sales, they attempted a change in business strategy.

examples.japanese: {急|きゅう}な{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}に{現場|げんば}は{混乱|こんらん}した。
examples.english: The sudden policy reversal caused confusion on the ground.

notes:
Compound of {方針|ほうしん} (policy, course of action) and {転換|てんかん} (conversion, switch). Very common in news reporting about political and corporate decisions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}を{図|はか}る — to attempt a policy shift
- {方針転換|ほうしんてんかん}を{迫|せま}られる — to be forced into a policy change
- {大幅|おおはば}な{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん} — a major policy shift
- {急|きゅう}な{方針転換|ほうしんてんかん} — a sudden change of course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {路線変更|ろせんへんこう}: change of policy/route — similar meaning, slightly more informal
- {軌道修正|きどうしゅうせい}: course correction — implies a smaller adjustment rather than a full reversal
- {転換|てんかん}: conversion, shift — the broader term without specifying it is about policy
